title: Breha Organa
description: Queen Breha Organa held many important roles in her life, and held most of them simultaneously. As the head of the royal family and the Minister of Education, she was responsible for the people of her planet in many ways. As the wife of Bail Organa and adoptive mother of Leia Organa, she also had her hands full working to keep her daughter safe and supported. While her husband worked in the Senate and helped build the nascent Rebellion, she nurtured and mentored students, even some who would join the Rebellion as Rebel pilots, like Evaan Verlaine.
